full_judgment: 2. The predecessors-in-interest of the respondent Nos. 1(Ka) to 1(Chha) and respondent Nos. 2(Ka) to 2(Ja) Monir Uddin Sheikh and Abdul Motaleb Shaikh respectively as plaintiffs filed Title Suit No. 253 of 1986 for declaration of their title and possession in the suit land, which they acquired through purchase from Kallayani Debi, and that the defendants claiming owner-ship in the suit land by creating forged sale deed dispossessed the plaintiffs from the 'Kha' schedule land during the pendency of the suit on 20.12.1986 and for which the plaintiffs subsequently prayed for recovery of khas possession of the 'Kha' schedule land.
